final_script:
User story: "As a signed-in customer on https://www.saucedemo.com, I want to log out from the side menu so that my session ends securely. Acceptance criteria: after logging in with 'standard_user' / 'secret_sauce', clicking the burger menu button '#react-burger-menu-btn' opens the side menu, clicking the logout link '#logout_sidebar_link' returns me to the login page, and the login button [data-test='login-button'] is visible again."
Category: authentication
Complexity: medium
